citations.assessment: Rabbi Yannai bar Nachmani reports Shmuel’s statement about three uses of exaggeration, naming the altar heap, the vine and the curtain.
The separate Yaakov entry repeats the conjecture. Chullin attests Yaakov bar Nachmani reporting Shmuel, which supports the common patronymic and teacher without establishing a sibling relationship.
